children: Alligo will publish its interim report for the third quarter 2026 on Friday October 23, at 8:00 a.m. CEST. A webcasted telephone conference will be held the same day at 11:00 a.m CEST where Samuel Alteborg, President and CEO and Irene Wisenborn Bellander, CFO and Deputy CEO will present the results and answer questions.

The conference call and presentation are available on the web or by telephone in accordance with the details below. Questions can be asked via the webcast (written) or by logging in to the conference call.
Participants need to register in advance of the conference call using the link above. Upon registering, each participant will be provided with Participant Dial-In Number, and a unique Personal PIN.
The presentation will be held in English and the material will be available at www.alligo.com before the conference starts. A replay of the webcast will be available on the website afterwards.
Irene Wisenborn Bellander, CFO & Deputy CEO

Alligo is a leading player in workwear, personal protection, tools and consumables in the Nordics. Sales mainly take place through the concept brands Swedol in Sweden and Tools in Norway and Finland, via stores, field sales and telesales, digital sales and on-site service. Alligo also has non-integrated businesses in selected product and technology areas, such as product media, welding and batteries which operate stores under their own brands. The group has around 2,500 employees and a turnover of around SEK 9.8 billion per year. Alligo AB (publ) is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. Read more at alligo.com
